think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and valid range from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether any in-range numeric value is designated as a sentinel (e.g., -1, 0) that changes the knob’s meaning beyond the normal ordered scaling (such as ‘auto’, ‘disable’, or ‘unlimited’). 3) Determine if that sentinel causes qualitatively different behavior rather than just ‘less/more’. 4) If such a sentinel exists, classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s); otherwise classify as not special.
